Jet Quirk.name: Jet Quirk
Jet Quirk.description:
💨 You turn inhaled air into bursts of movement through vents in your soles.

🌱 At the start you cross about ten meters in a burst, clear a waist-high obstacle, add momentum to a strike and land on clear ground.
📈 With training: fast wall rebounds, sharp turns, passenger rescues, longer pursuit routes.
⚠️ You spend stored breath; smoke and blocked vents stop safe bursts, weak or slippery surfaces spoil rebounds, and speed gives no protection from collisions.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Finite Fuel, as propulsion uses air you must breathe in again.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Sorahiko Torino / Gran Torino's Jet. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Quirk fuel pack x5, Fuel belt

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Control +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Sole Vent Dash, Air Driven Shoulder
Jet Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: inhaled air blasts from sole vents; thrust follows the soles (turn legs, plant a foot or rebound to steer). Start: about 10 m bursts, waist-high hops, basic clear-ground landings. Rapid rebounds, passengers, long pursuit need training.
Limits: bursts spend stored air; smoke or a blocked airway stops refills; sealed shoes or pinned feet block exhaust. Moves the body only, no blades or wind. No impact resistance; bad turns break bones; weak, slick or fragile surfaces fail rebounds.
Quirk Strain: light: dash, checked shoulder hit; moderate: rebound, passenger carry, braking; heavy: rapid multi-opponent sequence; severe: max acceleration, sustained pursuit.
Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Sorahiko Torino / Gran Torino's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: avoid pedestrians; striking or carrying the unwilling needs self-defense or licensed duty.
Look: sole vents.
